operations.description:

Supports both role-based and permission-based access control:

- Permission-based (new): required_permissions, write_permissions, action_permissions

responseFields.name: offline_ref
responseFields.description: Device-namespaced number an offline sale was rung under (e.g. OFF-3FA9-000123). Stored for traceability so a printed offline receipt can be reconciled to its canonical invoice_no.

requestFields.name: warehouse
requestFields.description: Warehouse ID.

requestFields.name: customer
requestFields.description: Party ID of the customer.

requestFields.name: discount_type
requestFields.description: Order-level discount kind. Must be 'percentage' or 'fixed' (or empty for no order discount). Combines with each item.discount (line-level).

requestFields.name: discount_value
requestFields.description: The percentage (e.g. '10' = 10% off cart subtotal) or fixed amount (e.g. '50' = ₨50 off cart subtotal), depending on discount_type.

requestFields.name: discount_approved_by
requestFields.description: User ID who approved the discount.

requestFields.name: is_tax_inclusive
requestFields.description: If true, item.unit_price is treated as already including tax. Tax itself is computed server-side from each variant's configured tax rate — there is NO order-level tax override field. Set tax on the Product / Variant in the catalog.

requestFields.name: session_client_uuid
requestFields.description: client_uuid of an offline-opened session. Used to link a queued sale to its session once both have synced, when no integer session id is available yet.

requestFields.name: offline_ref
requestFields.description: Device-namespaced number an offline sale was rung under (e.g. OFF-3FA9-000123). Stored on the Sale for traceability; the canonical number is still the server-assigned invoice_no.

requestFields.name: coupon_code
requestFields.description: Optional coupon code. Validated + redeemed server-side; the associated Discount overrides discount_type/discount_value when the caller hasn't already set them. Invalid/expired/used-up codes raise 400.

requestFields.name: payments
requestFields.description: List of {"amount": <decimal>, "method": <str|optional>}

requestFields.name: currency_code
requestFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code stored on the Sale. Default PKR.

requestFields.name: exchange_rate
requestFields.description: Exchange rate to shop's base currency at the time of sale.

title: Khata (ledger)
intro: The running credit ledger. Every entry carries the balance after it, so you never have to sum the history yourself.

operations.description:
Read-only list of ledger entries plus manual adjustment creation.

Party-balance and ledger data is financially sensitive — list/retrieve
requires `parties.ledger` permission; manual adjustments require
`payments.allocate`. Previously every authenticated shop member could
read the entire AR/AP history (QA bug BUG-027 — leaks who-owes-whom).

title: Payments
intro: Money in or out, against a party. Always send an Idempotency-Key.

operations.description:
Base viewset that injects shop on create and applies tenant permissions.

``HasRole`` MUST be in ``permission_classes`` for the per-viewset
``action_permissions`` maps below to actually gate access. Without it the
maps are inert and every shop member (cashier, readonly) can POST
payments/refunds/cheque actions — the same BUG-027 the parties domain
already fixed (`domains/parties/api/viewsets.py`).

Base viewset that injects shop on create and applies tenant permissions.

``HasRole`` MUST be in ``permission_classes`` for the per-viewset
``action_permissions`` maps below to actually gate access. Without it the
maps are inert and every shop member (cashier, readonly) can POST
payments/refunds/cheque actions — the same BUG-027 the parties domain
already fixed (`domains/parties/api/viewsets.py`).

requestFields.name: payment_direction
requestFields.description:
* `in` - Inbound
* `out` - Outbound

requestFields.name: session
requestFields.description: POS session this payment was collected during (required for distribution-register reconciliation).

requestFields.name: purchase
requestFields.description: Optional Purchase ID — when set, the payment is allocated to that purchase and updates its paid_amount / balance_due / payment_status.

requestFields.name: sale
requestFields.description: Optional Sale ID — when set, the payment is allocated to that sale and updates its paid_amount / balance_due / payment_status.

requestFields.name: allocations
requestFields.description: Optional list of explicit allocations to settle multiple documents from this single payment. Each item must reference a `sale` OR `purchase` id (belonging to this shop) plus an `amount`. When supplied, PaymentAllocation rows are created and each target document's paid_amount / balance_due / payment_status is advanced. References to nonexistent or foreign documents are rejected with 400.
